wuOverlaps.method: vertices sunk into a higher-priority structure (taken as a filled body) move just beyond the nearest point of its surface (0.5 mm clearance, at most 8 mm); order = WU_PRIORITY

bladder.method: her scanned bladder kept for size and dome; the point of its wall nearest the top of the Wu urethra pulled onto it, and the point of its base nearest the Wu vagina drawn to 2 mm from the anterior vaginal wall, by Gaussian fields (σ 12 mm), the volume restored by a uniform scaling about the apex of the dome (three rounds); wall then slid out of Wu structures (1 mm gap)

uterusBladder.decision: the uterus is left where the specimen has it and no bladder filling is invented: the gap is narrowest between the back of the empty bladder and the cervix, below the isthmus, so turning the uterine body forwards about the isthmus does not close it (see the trial rotations) while it would carry the fundus, tubes, ovaries and round ligaments of the specimen along by the distances given

hraLigaments.method: smooth field from the correspondences HRA organ → Wu organ (uterus: similarity ICP; ovaries, tubes, vagina: centroid and volume) with the pelvic bones held fixed; then slid out of Wu organs, bladder and bone (≤ 15 mm); dropped unless ≤ 5 % of the surface is inside a solid, the part comes within 6 mm of the organ it belongs to and its area changed by less than 2.5×; of a pair both sides are dropped when one fails

rectosigmoid.method: Gaussian translation field centred on the lower end of the warped sigmoid colon (σ = max(30 mm, 0.8 × shift)), applied to all warped bowel and the vessels and nodes hanging on it

bowel.method: the bowel is a closed tube: it is shifted as a whole by Gaussian translation fields centred on the organ it contains (direction and size chosen to clear the organ at least cost), never by pushing its surface

pelvicLigaments.method: each HRA ligament is taken as a row of cross-sections on its principal axis; the cross-sections are kept and re-strung on a taut path from one attachment to the other (nodes that fall within 3 mm of an organ give way in one direction: lateral for the uterosacral ligaments, downward for the others), then slid out of organs and bone (0.5 mm). Uterine attachment: same fraction of the uterine height as in the HRA model, posterolateral (uterosacral; turned towards lateral in steps of 15° until the path is clear of the rectum) or lateral (cardinal, ovarian). The end on the sacrum or the pelvic wall stays where HRA put it
pelvicLigaments.rule: shipped when the new length is 0.5–1.5 × the modelled length, the path is clear of the organs, at most 2 % of the surface folds over, at most 5 % of the surface lies inside organs or bone and both ends come within 3 mm of what they attach to; left and right are judged separately, so one side can be present without the other

what.en: Separate toes, web spaces and nails: the donor is a CC0 base mesh (not this person's foot, and without a skeleton). Each toe is placed by this body's chain of toe bones: the donor tip on the end of the distal phalanx plus a 3 mm soft-tissue pad, the donor web on the web station of the proximal phalanx; the cross-section is scaled per toe and pushed out locally where bone cover would be short. Behind the webs the surface lies on the package skin. Every vertex was deformed in this way (tag graftCurated); the band at the rim is the blend ring (graftBlend, construction).

Bones, leg and pelvis muscles and some organs come from one donor (Visible Human Female: CT and the University of Denver cryosection models, 184 parts), but they were re-posed and then scaled segment by segment to the proportions of an average young woman (stature 160.6 cm), so no part keeps the donor's true size or proportions; all are labelled "warped". The other 3101 parts are male anatomy deformed onto that skeleton.
cautions.zh: 本模型是构建出来的“标准女性”，并非某一位女性的扫描。骨骼、下肢和骨盆的肌以及部分器官来自同一位供体（Visible Human Female：CT 和丹佛大学的冰冻切片模型，共 184 个部件），但都重新摆过姿势，并逐肢段缩放到年轻女性的平均比例（身高 160.6 cm），因此没有任何部件保留供体的真实大小和比例，一律标为“形变”。其余 3101 个部件是形变贴合到这副骨架上的男性结构。

cautions.en: Proportions are imposed, not measured: segment lengths follow regressions fitted to US Army and US civilian surveys, evaluated at the mean stature of Chinese women aged 20–24. The trunk was shortened, the shoulder girdle lowered by about 7 cm, the forearms and lower legs lengthened, the pelvis narrowed by about 11 % and the feet flattened by about 20 %; the muscle envelope of the arms, chest wall, thighs and calves was thinned to fit the girths of a woman of BMI 21.6. Do not read individual bone shape, joint congruency or muscle bulk from this model.
cautions.zh: 比例是设定的，不是测得的：各肢段长度按美国陆军和美国平民测量数据拟合的回归式取值，身高取中国 20–24 岁女性的均值。躯干被缩短，肩带下移约 7 cm，前臂和小腿被加长，骨盆收窄约 11 %，足被压低约 20 %；上肢、胸壁、大腿和小腿的肌肉包络被收薄，以符合 BMI 21.6 女性的围度。不要据此模型判断单块骨的形状、关节的吻合程度或肌肉的粗细。

cautions.en: Most leg and pelvis muscles are spliced: the belly is the donor's (Denver cryosection model, bellies only) and the tendons are cut from the male muscle and moved to meet it, so the junction between belly and tendon is a join, not anatomy. Where no clean join was possible (gastrocnemius, gracilis, sartorius, semimembranosus, semitendinosus, gluteus minimus) the male muscle is shown instead. Vessels and nerves of the leg are male structures fitted to her muscles afterwards. 2.0 % of nerve length lies more than 3 mm inside her own muscles: 1.8 % are motor branches entering the muscle they supply, 0.2 % are known passages through a muscle, and 0.1 % is not explained by anatomy. In the groin the course that the ilio-inguinal nerve and the genital branch of the genitofemoral nerve take in the male, down into the scrotum, was cut off (45–86 mm); here these nerves end at the mons pubis. The femoral vessels were moved back by up to 24.7 mm to lie on her own muscles; other vessels, nerves and lymph nodes in front of those muscles moved with them. The great saphenous vein joins the femoral vein at the level of the pubic tubercle, higher than in life, as it does in the male model.
cautions.zh: 下肢和骨盆的肌大多是拼接的：肌腹来自供体（Denver 冰冻切片模型，只有肌腹），肌腱则取自男性的同名肌并移到与肌腹对齐，所以肌腹与肌腱的交界是拼接出来的，不是真实解剖。无法干净拼接的肌（腓肠肌、股薄肌、缝匠肌、半膜肌、半腱肌、臀小肌）仍用男性的肌。下肢的血管和神经是男性结构，事后按她的肌调整了位置。神经总长的 2.0 % 位于她自己的肌内 3 mm 以上：其中 1.8 % 是进入所支配肌的肌支，0.2 % 是已知的穿肌段，0.1 % 无法用解剖解释。腹股沟处，髂腹股沟神经和生殖股神经生殖支在男性进入阴囊的一段已剪去（45–86 mm），在这里这两条神经止于阴阜。股血管向后移了最多 24.7 mm，贴在她自己的肌上；这些肌前方的其他血管、神经和淋巴结随之移动。大隐静脉在耻骨结节的高度汇入股静脉，比真实位置高，与男性模型相同。

cautions.en: Warped parts are anchored by bone only. Between bones their position is extrapolated: expect errors of 1–3 cm for limb muscles, vessels and nerves, and more in the abdomen and pelvis.
cautions.zh: 形变部件仅以骨骼为锚点，骨与骨之间的位置靠外推得到：四肢的肌肉、血管和神经误差约 1–3 cm，腹部和盆腔更大。

cautions.en: The pelvic floor, the anal and urethral sphincters, the perineal muscles, clitoris and vestibular bulbs, the urethra, vagina, rectum and anal canal, uterus, tubes and ovaries (51 parts) are real female anatomy, but of ANOTHER woman, not of the donor of the skeleton (Wu et al. 2015: a young adult of the Chinese Visible Human series). Her structures were reconstructed from cryosections and smoothed by the authors of that study, enlarged 1.096 times and fitted to this pelvis by its bones (to about 2 mm), then narrowed by 11 % together with the pelvis. Left and right halves were separated by this project, and where neighbouring structures overlapped the less important one was reshaped by up to 8 mm. Do not read sizes, exact positions or left–right differences from these parts.
cautions.zh: 盆底肌、肛门括约肌和尿道括约肌、会阴肌、阴蒂和前庭球、尿道、阴道、直肠和肛管、子宫、输卵管和卵巢（共 51 个部件）是真实的女性解剖结构，但来自另一位女性，不是这副骨架的供体（Wu 等 2015 年的研究：中国可视化人体数据集中的一位年轻成年女性）。这些结构由该研究的作者根据冰冻切片重建并做过平滑，本模型把它们放大 1.096 倍，按骨性标志配准到这个骨盆上（误差约 2 mm），又随骨盆一起横向收窄 11 %。左右两半是本项目切分的；相邻结构有重叠的地方，次要的一方被重新塑形，最多移动 8 mm。不要据此判断这些结构的大小、精确位置或左右差异。

cautions.en: Three sources meet in the lesser pelvis, and where they meet the model is a join, not anatomy. The bladder, bones and obturator internus are the donor's; her bladder is almost empty (35.7 ml), its neck was drawn 12.1 mm onto the upper end of the other woman's urethra and its base 13 mm back onto the anterior vaginal wall. The uterus stands as it did in the other woman, whose bladder was full, so an unnatural gap remains between bladder and uterus. The sigmoid colon, ureters, vessels, nerves and lymph nodes are male structures: the end of the sigmoid colon was moved 19.6 mm to meet the upper end of the rectum (which is cut off at the top of the specimen), the bowel was shifted by up to 32 mm to clear the uterus, left tube and left ovary, and vessels that ran through these organs were pushed to their surface; some still cut through them. Uterine artery, Uterine vein, Mesovarium, Suspensory ligament of ovary, Uterovesical pouch are artist models (Human Reference Atlas) moved 2–4 cm onto these organs. The left uterosacral ligament (82.2 → 51.1 mm), right cardinal ligament (72.5 → 43.2 mm), right uterosacral ligament (82.2 → 62 mm) are artist models (Human Reference Atlas) re-fitted by two ends: the end on the sacrum or pelvic wall was kept, the other end was moved onto the cervix shown here, and the ligament was shortened along its length. They are schematic bands between attachment sites taken from textbook anatomy, not dissected ligaments. That gap (16.6 mm) lies between the back of the empty bladder and the cervix; tilting the uterine body forwards by up to 30° would not close it, so the uterus was left as in the specimen. The posterior vaginal wall and the rectum are apposed through the rectovaginal septum (closer than 1 mm over 36 mm²).
cautions.zh: 小骨盆里有三个来源的结构，它们相接的地方是拼接出来的，不是真实解剖。膀胱、骨和闭孔内肌来自骨架的供体；她的膀胱几乎是空的（35.7 ml），膀胱颈被拉动 12.1 mm 接到另一位女性的尿道上端，膀胱底向后移了 13 mm 贴近阴道前壁。子宫保持它在另一位女性体内的位置，而那位女性的膀胱是充盈的，所以膀胱与子宫之间留有一段不自然的空隙。乙状结肠、输尿管、血管、神经和淋巴结是男性结构：乙状结肠末端被移动 19.6 mm 去对接直肠上端（直肠在标本上缘处被截断），肠管整体移动了最多 32 mm 以避开子宫、左输卵管和左卵巢，原本穿过这些器官的血管被推到器官表面，仍有少数从中穿过。子宫动脉、子宫静脉、卵巢系膜、卵巢悬韧带、膀胱子宫陷凹是美术建模（Human Reference Atlas），被移动 2–4 cm 贴到这些器官上。左骶子宫韧带（82.2 → 51.1 mm）、右主韧带（72.5 → 43.2 mm）、右骶子宫韧带（82.2 → 62 mm）是美术模型（Human Reference Atlas），按两端重新配准：骶骨或盆壁一端保持原位，另一端移到这里显示的宫颈上，韧带沿长轴缩短。它们是连接附着点的示意性条带（附着点按教科书解剖确定），不是解剖出来的韧带。这段空隙（16.6 mm）位于空膀胱后壁与宫颈之间，把子宫体前倾 30° 也合不上，所以子宫保持标本中的位置。阴道后壁与直肠隔着直肠阴道隔相贴（相距不足 1 mm 的面积为 36 mm²）。

cautions.en: The arms are not where her bones were posed. Her upper limbs lay against her sides, with latissimus dorsi, teres major and pectoralis major so close to the arm that no skin could pass between arm and trunk (8.8 / 8.7 mm, left / right, at 40–45% of the length of the humerus). Each free limb, with everything in it, was therefore turned 7.5° outwards in the coronal plane about the centre of the humeral head, the smallest angle that leaves 12 mm there (now 13.9 / 13.1 mm); the scapulae and clavicles were not moved. The 39 muscles, tendons and ligaments that cross the shoulder joint and the vessels and nerves of the axilla were deformed to follow (160 parts), so their shape there is constructed. Proximal to that level the axillary folds still lie against the arm, as they do in life.
cautions.zh: 上肢不在她的骨原先摆放的位置。她的两臂原本贴在身侧，背阔肌、大圆肌和胸大肌紧挨着上臂，臂与躯干之间没有皮肤能通过的空隙（肱骨长度 40–45% 处，左 / 右 8.8 / 8.7 mm）。因此把每侧游离上肢连同其中的一切，绕肱骨头中心在冠状面内向外转了 7.5°——这是在该处让出 12 mm 的最小角度（现在为 13.9 / 13.1 mm）；肩胛骨和锁骨没有动。跨过肩关节的 39 个肌、腱、韧带以及腋窝的血管、神经随之形变（共 160 个部件），它们在该处的形状是构造出来的。该平面以近，腋襞仍贴着上臂，活体也是如此。

cautions.en: The body surface is a parametric model skin (Momentum Human Rig (MHR) v1.0.1), not a scan and not her own skin: a surface shaped as a standard female body and then relaxed outwards over her muscles until it encloses them. It is heavier than intended: BMI 23.71 by enclosed volume against a target of 21.6. The shoulders and upper arms are fuller than the target (bideltoid breadth 478 mm against 454 mm). Under the arms the skin of the upper arm still runs into the skin of the trunk: by the skin author's measurement about 12.5 cm² on the left and 2.5 cm² on the right, between 25 % and 50 % of the length of the humerus.
cautions.zh: 体表是参数化模型皮肤（Momentum Human Rig (MHR) v1.0.1），不是扫描所得，也不是她本人的皮肤：先做成标准女性体形的表面，再向外松弛到把她的肌肉包住。它比设定的要胖：按所围体积算 BMI 为 23.71，目标是 21.6。肩部和上臂比目标粗（两侧三角肌间宽 478 mm，目标 454 mm）。腋窝处上臂内侧的皮肤仍穿入躯干的皮肤：按皮肤作者的测量，左侧约 12.5 cm²、右侧约 2.5 cm²，在肱骨长度的 25–50 % 之间。

cautions.en: The navel is not hers: it is a dimple constructed in the skin (5.3 mm deep, 17 mm wide, an assumed size), set at the level of the centre of the body of the fourth lumbar vertebra. The crotch of the skin was raised towards her perineal structures, by up to 24.4 mm; the points it was drawn towards still lie a median 6.2 mm and at most 28.4 mm from it. It carries no vulvar anatomy (no labia, vestibule or openings): the perineal skin of the pelvic-floor specimen was located on her but could not be set into the skin (the rim of the patch still lies a median 7.6 mm from the skin; the cut plane of the specimen runs through the walls of the cleft, so part of the rim of the patch is not a real edge of skin; with it the skin would not be a closed manifold).
cautions.zh: 脐不是她本人的：是在皮肤上构造出来的一个小凹（深 5.3 mm，宽 17 mm，尺寸是假定的），高度取第四腰椎椎体中心。皮肤的会阴部已朝她的会阴结构抬高，最多 24.4 mm；它所趋向的目标点离它仍有中位数 6.2 mm、最远 28.4 mm。它没有外阴的解剖结构（没有阴唇、前庭和开口）：盆底标本的会阴皮肤已在她身上定位，但没能接进皮肤（这一片的外缘离皮肤中位数 7.6 mm；标本的截面穿过中线裂的两壁，这一片的外缘有一部分不是真实的皮肤边缘；接入后皮肤不再是闭合流形）。

cautions.en: Her head is the face of the skin model's target shape set on her skull, not a face of her own. It was pushed out only as far as her bones need cover, not over the muscles of facial expression: 9 of them lie partly outside the skin, by up to 2.2 mm in this build (orbicularis oris). The lids of the skin lie over her eyeballs, but the eye joints of the skin model, about which its eyes would turn, sit about 5 mm further from the midline on each side than the centres of her eyeballs. The eyes, the mouth and the nose are the skin model's.
cautions.zh: 她的头是皮肤模型目标体形的面孔，摆在她的颅骨上，不是她本人的面孔。皮肤只外推到给骨留出覆盖，没有包住表情肌：有 9 块表情肌部分露在皮肤外，本次构建量得最多 2.2 mm。皮肤的眼睑盖在她的眼球上，但皮肤模型的眼关节（它的眼绕之转动的点）比她的眼球中心每侧偏外约 5 mm。眼、口、鼻都是皮肤模型的。

cautions.en: The eyes and the mouth of the skin are real openings. The membrane between the lids was removed, so what shows in each eye is the globe of the anatomy data, and the lips are cut apart along the oral fissure (closed at rest). Behind the openings, the lid rims turned in towards the globes and the oral pouch round teeth, gums and tongue are construction aids that only hide the hollow inside of the body: they are not anatomy (there is no conjunctiva and no oral mucosa). The deep "Lip" part lies in the oral opening and is meant to be hidden while the skin is opaque.
cautions.zh: 皮肤上的眼和口是真正的开口：两睑之间的封膜已删去，洞里露出的是解剖数据里的眼球；上下唇沿口裂剪开，静止时闭合。洞口后面朝向眼球的睑缘内卷、包住牙、牙龈和舌的口腔袋都是构造物，只为不露出体内的空腔，不是解剖（没有结膜，也没有口腔黏膜）。深层的“唇”部件正位于口裂处，皮肤不透明时应隐藏。

cautions.en: The toes are separate, with webs and nails, but they are not hers: they come from an artist-made foot mesh (Blender Studio Human Base Meshes, CC0), each toe placed along her toe bones and widened until it covers them; the third to fifth toes are stretched 1.25–1.55 times to reach along her phalanges and look slender; the nails are shapes in the skin mesh, apart from the nail plate parts. About 2 cm of skin behind the toe bases is a constructed transition (triangles up to 40 mm long). Where the web station lies on the proximal phalanx is an assumption.
cautions.zh: 足趾是分开的，有趾蹼和趾甲，但不是她本人的：取自人工建模的足部网格（Blender Studio Human Base Meshes，CC0），每个趾沿她的趾骨摆放并加粗到盖住趾骨；第 3–5 趾被拉长到 1.25–1.55 倍才够到她的趾骨，显得细长；趾甲是皮肤网格上的形状，与甲板部件无关。趾根之后约 2 cm 的皮肤是构造的过渡面（三角形最长 40 mm）。趾蹼在近节趾骨上的位置是假定的。

cautions.en: The grafted toes have visible faults: at the tips of the second and third toes the surface is crumpled into small fragments, on both feet, and a faint step runs across the back of each forefoot where the graft meets the fitted skin. On the shipped mesh 99 edges of the left graft and 93 of the right are folded right over (neighbouring facets more than 150° apart).
cautions.zh: 移植的足趾有看得见的毛病：双足第二、三趾的趾尖表面皱成小碎片，足背前部移植片与拟合皮肤相接处有一道浅台阶。在发布的网格上，左足移植片有 99 条边、右足有 93 条边完全对折（相邻小面夹角超过 150°）。

cautions.en: Round the eyes and the lips the skin was deliberately not pushed out, and measured against the skin as it was before the openings were cut, what lies under it comes through: the inner (palpebral) ring of orbicularis oculi by up to 3.2 mm, its outer (orbital) ring by up to 1.2 mm, the lips by 0.9 mm, the nasal cartilages by up to 2.6 mm. The face keeps the full resolution of the surface (16260 vertices, mean edge 1.74 mm), as do the grafted patches; the rest of the skin is simplified.
cautions.zh: 眼和唇周围的皮肤有意不外推；按开口之前的皮肤量，有结构露出皮肤：眼轮匝肌内环（睑部）最多 3.2 mm、外环（眶部）最多 1.2 mm、唇 0.9 mm、鼻软骨最多 2.6 mm。面部保留体表的原始分辨率（16260 个顶点，平均边长 1.74 mm），移植片也是；其余皮肤经过简化。

cautions.en: The breasts on the surface are the skin model's, shaped to Chinese reference figures (sternal notch to nipple 190.5 mm, nipples 200 mm apart, 332.5 mL each); by the skin author's measurement they came out at 188 mm (left) and 191 mm (right) from the notch, 194 mm apart, 334 and 334 mL.
cautions.zh: 体表上的乳房是皮肤模型的，按中国女性的参考数值塑形（胸骨上切迹到乳头 190.5 mm，两乳头相距 200 mm，每侧 332.5 mL）；按皮肤作者的测量，做出来是切迹到乳峰 188 mm（左）和 191 mm（右），相距 194 mm，334 和 334 mL。

cautions.en: The gland, ducts, fat, areola and nipple inside the breasts of the skin are an artist model (Human Reference Atlas) of a larger breast in standing shape (by the skin author's measurement it projects 79 mm (left) and 82 mm (right) from the chest wall, the breast of the skin 56 mm and 54 mm), scaled to 0.51 of its size on both sides and moved about 3 cm down, as the placement file of the skin package says, to fit under that skin. Their size and their place on the chest wall are therefore not anatomical data.
cautions.zh: 皮肤的乳房之内的腺体、导管、脂肪、乳晕和乳头是美术模型（Human Reference Atlas），原本是更大的站立位乳房（前突 79 / 82 mm，皮肤的乳房只有 56 / 54 mm，皮肤作者量），按皮肤包的摆放文件两侧都缩小到原大小的 0.51，并下移约 3 cm，才放得进这层皮肤。因此它们的大小和在胸壁上的位置都不是解剖数据。

cautions.en: The skin was fitted to enclose muscles, bones, cartilages and organs only. Fasciae, cutaneous nerves and superficial vessels lying on them were not considered, and 0.7% of their surface comes through the skin, by up to 5 mm (dorsal digital branches of radial nerve). Surface parts made for the earlier skin do not sit on this one: perionyx (foot), nail plate (foot), nail plate, pubic hair, hair of head, perionyx, tarsal plate of left lower eyelid.
cautions.zh: 皮肤拟合时只保证包住肌、骨、软骨和器官，贴在它们外面的筋膜、皮神经和浅血管没有考虑：这些结构的表面有 0.7% 露在皮肤之外，最多 5 mm。为旧皮肤制作的体表部件（头发、眉、外耳、甲、阴毛等）与这层皮肤对不上。

cautions.en: Muscle bulk and position were then changed again to fit a target body surface: a parametric female skin (stature 160.6 cm, BMI 21.6) less the subcutaneous fat expected at each place. Muscles, tendons, warped organs, vessels and nerves were pushed in, and in places pulled out, by up to 28.8 mm with one smooth field that is zero on bone; 57 muscles lost more than a quarter of their volume (calf, abdominal wall, forearm extensors, neck). 12 % of the muscle and organ surface still lies outside that target, mostly thin muscle lying directly on bone. On the head and neck the target surface is a face built on her skull from published soft-tissue depths (8 % of the muscle surface of the head and 18 % of that of the neck still lie outside it; sternocleidomastoid, which is her own and comes from a heavier donor, most of all). The lips were moved forwards to lie under its lip surface (lip by 3.8 mm, orbicularis oris by 8.2 mm, median) as a whole, and the muscles that run into the lips follow at their labial end and keep their bony origins (their volume changed by at most 100 %). The hands were left as they are: her finger bones have moved since the target was made and its fingers no longer fit them. Muscle thickness, cross-section and volume in this model are therefore not anatomical data.
cautions.zh: 之后又按一个目标体表改动了肌肉的粗细和位置：目标是参数化的女性皮肤（身高 160.6 cm，BMI 21.6）向内减去各处应有的皮下脂肪。肌、腱、形变来的器官、血管和神经被一个在骨面上为零的平滑位移场推入（个别地方拉出），最多 28.8 mm；57 块肌的体积减少了四分之一以上（小腿、腹壁、前臂伸肌、颈部）。仍有 12 % 的肌和器官表面在目标之外，主要是直接贴在骨上的薄肌。头颈部的目标体表是按她的颅骨和已发表的软组织厚度做的面部（头部肌表面仍有 8 %、颈部仍有 18 % 在目标之外，以胸锁乳突肌为最——它是她自己的，来自体重更大的供体）。唇被前移到目标唇面之下（唇 3.8 mm、口轮匝肌 8.2 mm，中位数），整块平移；止于唇的各肌靠唇的一端随之移动，骨上的起点不动（体积变化最多 100 %）。手没有参加这一步：目标做成之后她的指骨挪动过，目标的手指已对不上。因此本模型中肌肉的厚度、横截面和体积都不是解剖数据。
皮下脂肪层是在上述合成体表与她的肌肉、骨骼、器官外包络之间按 3 mm 体素填充得到的（最深只算到皮下 3 cm），并非扫描所得；其厚度取决于合成的皮肤，不代表女性真实的脂肪分布。
cautions.en: The subcutaneous fat layer fills the gap between that synthetic body surface and the outer envelope of her muscles, bones and organs at 3 mm voxels (no deeper than 3 cm below the skin); it is not scanned, and its thickness follows the synthetic skin rather than a real female fat distribution.

Absent from the pelvis: labia, vestibule and the skin of the vulva (the body surface there is smooth); the mucosa and lumen of the urethra; left cardinal ligament (only 10.1 mm between its attachments for a ligament modelled 70.5 mm long), left ovarian ligament (only 11.1 mm between its attachments for a ligament modelled 29.8 mm long), right ovarian ligament (only 4.1 mm between its attachments for a ligament modelled 31.2 mm long), broad ligament of uterus, left mesosalpinx, right mesosalpinx (the tubes lie against the ovaries, and in this specimen the peritoneum beside the uterus lies directly on tube and ovary; only 20–28 % of it is free, in scraps, so there is no fold to show); ovarian and vaginal vessels; the autonomic pelvic plexuses. The iliococcygeus is not a separate part: the source describes the pubococcygeus and iliococcygeus together as a "pubovisceral muscle" with an inner and an external layer. Male-only parts (prostate, testes, penis, seminal vesicles, testicular vessels, male urethra) and the male pelvic floor and rectum were removed, as were male structures that would lie inside the female organs (postvesical nodes).
cautions.zh: 盆腔中缺失的结构：阴唇、阴道前庭和外阴皮肤（该处的体表是光滑的）；尿道的黏膜和管腔；左主韧带（两附着点之间只有 10.1 mm，而模型中的韧带长 70.5 mm）、左卵巢固有韧带（两附着点之间只有 11.1 mm，而模型中的韧带长 29.8 mm）、右卵巢固有韧带（两附着点之间只有 4.1 mm，而模型中的韧带长 31.2 mm）、子宫阔韧带、左输卵管系膜、右输卵管系膜（输卵管紧贴卵巢，该标本中子宫旁的腹膜直接贴在输卵管和卵巢上，游离的只有 20–28 %，且是碎片，没有可显示的皱襞）；卵巢血管和阴道血管；盆腔自主神经丛。髂尾肌不是单独的部件：数据来源把耻尾肌和髂尾肌合称“耻骨内脏肌”，分为内层和外层。男性特有结构（前列腺、睾丸、阴茎、精囊、睾丸血管、男性尿道）以及男性的盆底肌和直肠已删除，落在女性器官内部的男性结构（postvesical nodes）也已删除。

cautions.en: Pose is reconstructed: the donor was scanned lying down with bent elbows and pointed feet, and each bone was moved rigidly into a standing pose. Joint spaces at the elbow, knee, ankle and shoulder are approximate, and the scapulae and clavicles keep their lying-down position. Her left acromion is about 16 mm shorter in front than the right in the CT segmentation, and the origin of the left deltoid overhangs it.
cautions.zh: 姿势是重建的：供体扫描时为仰卧、屈肘、足跖屈，各骨被逐一刚性移动到站立姿势。肘、膝、踝、肩的关节间隙只是近似，肩胛骨和锁骨仍保持仰卧时的位置。CT 分割出的左肩峰前端比右侧短约 16 mm，左三角肌的起点有一部分悬在它前方。

cautions.en: Right radius, ulna and the bones of both hands and feet are not her scanned bones: the right forearm is a mirrored copy of the left (the scan cut it off), and hand and foot bones are warped male bones with extended fingers. The finger bones lie beyond her own hand anchors; each finger was turned at its knuckle so that the angles within the hand are those of the male hand. Her toe bones are male bones scaled to her toes; the registration had left them lifted 13–22° at the ball of the foot, and they were laid back on the floor at the joint angles of the male foot (now -20° to -5°; the outer toes slope down more steeply than the male's because her outer metatarsal heads sit higher). The ankle is still about 16 mm too high (lateral malleolus 77.5 mm against 61.8 mm): lowering it further would distort her tarsal bones.
cautions.zh: 右侧桡骨、尺骨以及双手、双足的骨并非她的扫描骨：右前臂是左前臂的镜像（扫描视野将其截断），手骨和足骨是形变后的男性骨，手指呈伸直状。指骨在她自己的手骨锚点之外；每根手指在掌指关节处转过一个角度，使手内的角度与男性的手相同。她的趾骨是男性的骨，按她足趾的大小缩放；配准后趾骨在跖趾关节处上翘 13–22°，现已按男性足的关节角度放回地面（现为 -20° 至 -5°；外侧几趾比男性的更向下倾，因为她外侧的跖骨头位置偏高）。踝仍高出约 16 mm（外踝 77.5 mm，目标 61.8 mm）：再降低就会使她的跗骨变形。

cautions.en: The donor had six lumbar vertebrae. A standard five-lumbar spine is shown: her first lumbar vertebra was removed and everything above it moved down by one segment, so the thoracolumbar junction is a join, not anatomy. Rib numbering comes from automatic segmentation and is unreliable for left ribs 5–9.
cautions.zh: 供体有六节腰椎。这里显示的是标准的五节腰椎：去掉了她的第一腰椎，其上方的全部结构下移一个椎节，因此胸腰交界处是拼接出来的，不是真实解剖。肋骨编号来自自动分割，左侧第 5–9 肋的编号不可靠。

cautions.en: Her scanned organs (kidneys, spleen, pancreas, adrenals, gallbladder, bladder, gluteal muscles) are in lying-down, post-mortem position and do not always meet the warped vessels and ducts that should connect to them. Lungs, heart, liver, stomach and bowel are warped male organs.
cautions.zh: 她的扫描器官（肾、脾、胰、肾上腺、胆囊、膀胱、臀肌）处于仰卧、死后的位置，与本应相连的形变血管和管道不一定对得上。肺、心、肝、胃和肠是形变后的男性器官。

cautions.en: Everything said about the male model also applies to the warped parts: nerves, ligaments and lymph nodes are artist-modelled with schematic nerve thickness; phrenic nerve, pleura, pericardium, spinal cord, menisci and cruciate ligaments are absent.
cautions.zh: 男性模型的各项注意事项同样适用于形变部件：神经、韧带和淋巴结为美术建模，神经粗细仅为示意；膈神经、胸膜、心包、脊髓、半月板和交叉韧带缺失。

notes: This is a constructed standard female, not a scan of one person. Bones, leg and pelvis muscles and some organs come from one donor (Visible Human Female: CT and the University of Denver cryosection models, 184 parts), but they were re-posed and then scaled segment by segment to the proportions of an average young woman (stature 160.6 cm), so no part keeps the donor's true size or proportions; all are labelled "warped". The other 3101 parts are male anatomy deformed onto that skeleton.

Proportions are imposed, not measured: segment lengths follow regressions fitted to US Army and US civilian surveys, evaluated at the mean stature of Chinese women aged 20–24. The trunk was shortened, the shoulder girdle lowered by about 7 cm, the forearms and lower legs lengthened, the pelvis narrowed by about 11 % and the feet flattened by about 20 %; the muscle envelope of the arms, chest wall, thighs and calves was thinned to fit the girths of a woman of BMI 21.6. Do not read individual bone shape, joint congruency or muscle bulk from this model.

Most leg and pelvis muscles are spliced: the belly is the donor's (Denver cryosection model, bellies only) and the tendons are cut from the male muscle and moved to meet it, so the junction between belly and tendon is a join, not anatomy. Where no clean join was possible (gastrocnemius, gracilis, sartorius, semimembranosus, semitendinosus, gluteus minimus) the male muscle is shown instead. Vessels and nerves of the leg are male structures fitted to her muscles afterwards. 2.0 % of nerve length lies more than 3 mm inside her own muscles: 1.8 % are motor branches entering the muscle they supply, 0.2 % are known passages through a muscle, and 0.1 % is not explained by anatomy. In the groin the course that the ilio-inguinal nerve and the genital branch of the genitofemoral nerve take in the male, down into the scrotum, was cut off (45–86 mm); here these nerves end at the mons pubis. The femoral vessels were moved back by up to 24.7 mm to lie on her own muscles; other vessels, nerves and lymph nodes in front of those muscles moved with them. The great saphenous vein joins the femoral vein at the level of the pubic tubercle, higher than in life, as it does in the male model.
Warped parts are anchored by bone only. Between bones their position is extrapolated: expect errors of 1–3 cm for limb muscles, vessels and nerves, and more in the abdomen and pelvis.

The pelvic floor, the anal and urethral sphincters, the perineal muscles, clitoris and vestibular bulbs, the urethra, vagina, rectum and anal canal, uterus, tubes and ovaries (51 parts) are real female anatomy, but of ANOTHER woman, not of the donor of the skeleton (Wu et al. 2015: a young adult of the Chinese Visible Human series). Her structures were reconstructed from cryosections and smoothed by the authors of that study, enlarged 1.096 times and fitted to this pelvis by its bones (to about 2 mm), then narrowed by 11 % together with the pelvis. Left and right halves were separated by this project, and where neighbouring structures overlapped the less important one was reshaped by up to 8 mm. Do not read sizes, exact positions or left–right differences from these parts.

Three sources meet in the lesser pelvis, and where they meet the model is a join, not anatomy. The bladder, bones and obturator internus are the donor's; her bladder is almost empty (35.7 ml), its neck was drawn 12.1 mm onto the upper end of the other woman's urethra and its base 13 mm back onto the anterior vaginal wall. The uterus stands as it did in the other woman, whose bladder was full, so an unnatural gap remains between bladder and uterus. The sigmoid colon, ureters, vessels, nerves and lymph nodes are male structures: the end of the sigmoid colon was moved 19.6 mm to meet the upper end of the rectum (which is cut off at the top of the specimen), the bowel was shifted by up to 32 mm to clear the uterus, left tube and left ovary, and vessels that ran through these organs were pushed to their surface; some still cut through them. Uterine artery, Uterine vein, Mesovarium, Suspensory ligament of ovary, Uterovesical pouch are artist models (Human Reference Atlas) moved 2–4 cm onto these organs. The left uterosacral ligament (82.2 → 51.1 mm), right cardinal ligament (72.5 → 43.2 mm), right uterosacral ligament (82.2 → 62 mm) are artist models (Human Reference Atlas) re-fitted by two ends: the end on the sacrum or pelvic wall was kept, the other end was moved onto the cervix shown here, and the ligament was shortened along its length. They are schematic bands between attachment sites taken from textbook anatomy, not dissected ligaments. That gap (16.6 mm) lies between the back of the empty bladder and the cervix; tilting the uterine body forwards by up to 30° would not close it, so the uterus was left as in the specimen. The posterior vaginal wall and the rectum are apposed through the rectovaginal septum (closer than 1 mm over 36 mm²).

The arms are not where her bones were posed. Her upper limbs lay against her sides, with latissimus dorsi, teres major and pectoralis major so close to the arm that no skin could pass between arm and trunk (8.8 / 8.7 mm, left / right, at 40–45% of the length of the humerus). Each free limb, with everything in it, was therefore turned 7.5° outwards in the coronal plane about the centre of the humeral head, the smallest angle that leaves 12 mm there (now 13.9 / 13.1 mm); the scapulae and clavicles were not moved. The 39 muscles, tendons and ligaments that cross the shoulder joint and the vessels and nerves of the axilla were deformed to follow (160 parts), so their shape there is constructed. Proximal to that level the axillary folds still lie against the arm, as they do in life.

The body surface is a parametric model skin (Momentum Human Rig (MHR) v1.0.1), not a scan and not her own skin: a surface shaped as a standard female body and then relaxed outwards over her muscles until it encloses them. It is heavier than intended: BMI 23.71 by enclosed volume against a target of 21.6. The shoulders and upper arms are fuller than the target (bideltoid breadth 478 mm against 454 mm). Under the arms the skin of the upper arm still runs into the skin of the trunk: by the skin author's measurement about 12.5 cm² on the left and 2.5 cm² on the right, between 25 % and 50 % of the length of the humerus.

The navel is not hers: it is a dimple constructed in the skin (5.3 mm deep, 17 mm wide, an assumed size), set at the level of the centre of the body of the fourth lumbar vertebra. The crotch of the skin was raised towards her perineal structures, by up to 24.4 mm; the points it was drawn towards still lie a median 6.2 mm and at most 28.4 mm from it. It carries no vulvar anatomy (no labia, vestibule or openings): the perineal skin of the pelvic-floor specimen was located on her but could not be set into the skin (the rim of the patch still lies a median 7.6 mm from the skin; the cut plane of the specimen runs through the walls of the cleft, so part of the rim of the patch is not a real edge of skin; with it the skin would not be a closed manifold).

Her head is the face of the skin model's target shape set on her skull, not a face of her own. It was pushed out only as far as her bones need cover, not over the muscles of facial expression: 9 of them lie partly outside the skin, by up to 2.2 mm in this build (orbicularis oris). The lids of the skin lie over her eyeballs, but the eye joints of the skin model, about which its eyes would turn, sit about 5 mm further from the midline on each side than the centres of her eyeballs. The eyes, the mouth and the nose are the skin model's.

The eyes and the mouth of the skin are real openings. The membrane between the lids was removed, so what shows in each eye is the globe of the anatomy data, and the lips are cut apart along the oral fissure (closed at rest). Behind the openings, the lid rims turned in towards the globes and the oral pouch round teeth, gums and tongue are construction aids that only hide the hollow inside of the body: they are not anatomy (there is no conjunctiva and no oral mucosa). The deep "Lip" part lies in the oral opening and is meant to be hidden while the skin is opaque.

The toes are separate, with webs and nails, but they are not hers: they come from an artist-made foot mesh (Blender Studio Human Base Meshes, CC0), each toe placed along her toe bones and widened until it covers them; the third to fifth toes are stretched 1.25–1.55 times to reach along her phalanges and look slender; the nails are shapes in the skin mesh, apart from the nail plate parts. About 2 cm of skin behind the toe bases is a constructed transition (triangles up to 40 mm long). Where the web station lies on the proximal phalanx is an assumption.

The grafted toes have visible faults: at the tips of the second and third toes the surface is crumpled into small fragments, on both feet, and a faint step runs across the back of each forefoot where the graft meets the fitted skin. On the shipped mesh 99 edges of the left graft and 93 of the right are folded right over (neighbouring facets more than 150° apart).

Round the eyes and the lips the skin was deliberately not pushed out, and measured against the skin as it was before the openings were cut, what lies under it comes through: the inner (palpebral) ring of orbicularis oculi by up to 3.2 mm, its outer (orbital) ring by up to 1.2 mm, the lips by 0.9 mm, the nasal cartilages by up to 2.6 mm. The face keeps the full resolution of the surface (16260 vertices, mean edge 1.74 mm), as do the grafted patches; the rest of the skin is simplified.

The breasts on the surface are the skin model's, shaped to Chinese reference figures (sternal notch to nipple 190.5 mm, nipples 200 mm apart, 332.5 mL each); by the skin author's measurement they came out at 188 mm (left) and 191 mm (right) from the notch, 194 mm apart, 334 and 334 mL.

Their size and their place on the chest wall are therefore not anatomical data.

The skin was fitted to enclose muscles, bones, cartilages and organs only. Fasciae, cutaneous nerves and superficial vessels lying on them were not considered, and 0.7% of their surface comes through the skin, by up to 5 mm (dorsal digital branches of radial nerve). Surface parts made for the earlier skin do not sit on this one: perionyx (foot), nail plate (foot), nail plate, pubic hair, hair of head, perionyx, tarsal plate of left lower eyelid.

The lips were moved forwards to lie under its lip surface (lip by 3.8 mm, orbicularis oris by 8.2 mm, median) as a whole, and the muscles that run into the lips follow at their labial end and keep their bony origins (their volume changed by at most 100 %). The hands were left as they are: her finger bones have moved since the target was made and its fingers no longer fit them. Muscle thickness, cross-section and volume in this model are therefore not anatomical data.

Male-only parts (prostate, testes, penis, seminal vesicles, testicular vessels, male urethra) and the male pelvic floor and rectum were removed, as were male structures that would lie inside the female organs (postvesical nodes).

The finger bones lie beyond her own hand anchors; each finger was turned at its knuckle so that the angles within the hand are those of the male hand. The donor had six lumbar vertebrae. A standard five-lumbar spine is shown: her first lumbar vertebra was removed and everything above it moved down by one segment, so the thoracolumbar junction is a join, not anatomy. Rib numbering comes from automatic segmentation and is unreliable for left ribs 5–9.

Her scanned organs (kidneys, spleen, pancreas, adrenals, gallbladder, bladder, gluteal muscles) are in lying-down, post-mortem position and do not always meet the warped vessels and ducts that should connect to them. Lungs, heart, liver, stomach and bowel are warped male organs.
